paper_id: Chen et al. - 2012 - Optimizing Bloom Filter Settings in Peer-to-Peer Multikeyword Searching
title: Optimizing Bloom Filter Settings in Peer-to-Peer Multikeyword Searching
venue: IEEE Transactions on Knowledge and Data Engineering
motivation: P2P多关键词搜索的分布式交集/并集操作产生大量广域网流量成本
problem_framing: 优化BF参数设置以最小化通信流量,而非最小化假阳性率
key_insight: BF最优设置取决于两侧倒排列表的统计信息,而非最小化假阳性率
method_signature: 基于数值分析的BF最优参数推导与仿真验证
evaluation_criteria: 搜索流量与延迟的降低百分比
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 先前研究声称最小化假阳性率是最优的,实则不然
evidence_for_taste: minimizing the false positive of a BF is far from optimal settings
we show that this is not the case
optimal settings are determined by the global statistical information
the loss rate can become quite acceptable by using a BF with larger size
thinking_moves: 用数学证明反驳前人直觉性结论
从流量成本倒推BF参数优化目标
承认OR查询存在结果丢失并权衡精度
通过查询历史学习最优交集顺序
